tool_input.command:
python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import json
q=json.load(open('drafts/0002-quiz.json'));k=json.load(open('drafts/0002-key.json'))
qi={i['id']:i for i in q['items']};ki={i['id']:i for i in k['items']}
def o(*t): return [{"id":c,"text":x} for c,x in zip("abcd",t)]
qi['q3']['options']=o("An agent, because a model that chooses its own steps books more accurately","A workflow, because only a workflow can call the calendar and booking tools","An agent, because it makes fewer model calls than a workflow on simple requests","A workflow, because the steps are known ahead, so code can run them cheaply")
ki['q3']['rationale']="When the steps are known in advance, code can run them as a fixed workflow with fewer model calls, which is cheaper and more predictable. Option a is tempting because freedom sounds smarter, but nothing here needs the model to choose. Option b is tempting but both designs can call tools. Option c is tempting because agents adapt, but an agent spends extra calls deciding each next step."
ki['q3']['distractors']={"a":"M11","b":"M12","c":"M13"}
qi['q5']['options']=o("\"Check whether the laser cutter is free Friday at 3 pm and, if so, book it.\"","\"Show me the safety rules in the band saw manual before my session.\"","\"Find a machine that can make this part, compare options, and book one.\"","\"Which of my three training certificates expire this term?\"")
ki['q5']['answer']="c"
ki['q5']['rationale']="Finding a machine that fits has no fixed path: how many machines to look at and which tools to use are unknown in advance, so the model must choose each next step. Option a has several steps but the same ones every time. Option b is a fixed manual lookup. Option d is a fixed record lookup. A workflow handles all three."
ki['q5']['distractors']={"a":"M21","b":"M17","d":"M22"}
qi['q6']['stem']="Which of these is a true advantage of a fixed workflow over an agent?"
qi['q6']['options']=o("Its steps are set in code, so a request follows the same path each time","It handles requests nobody planned for, because the code adapts to them","It needs no model calls, because the code does all of the work","It gives more accurate answers than an agent on open-ended requests")
ki['q6']['rationale']="A fixed path is set in code, so behavior is predictable and easy to test and explain. Option b is tempting but reverses the two: adapting to the unplanned is what an agent does. Option c is tempting because code runs the steps, but a workflow still calls the model at its steps. Option d assumes fixed means more accurate, but a fixed path cannot adapt to open-ended work."
ki['q6']['distractors']={"b":"M18","c":"M19","d":"M20"}
ki['q4']['rationale']=ki['q4']['rationale']
json.dump(q,open('drafts/0002-quiz.json','w'),indent=2);json.dump(k,open('drafts/0002-key.json','w'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(q)[:50],[i['id'] for i in k['items']])
EOF
mkdir -p quizzes keys review-records; cp drafts/0002-quiz.json quizzes/0002.json; cp drafts/0002-key.json keys/0002.json
cat > review-records/0002-quiz.md <<'EOF'
# Review record: quiz 0002 (O4)

Passes: 2.

Pass 1 (REVISE): id collisions with the earlier key; odd-one-out cues in q2/q3; q5 was arithmetic and duplicated q3; cross-item leaks; bundled belief in q2 option c; no stretch item.
Changed: ids renumbered to M7+, one per belief; q2/q3 options mixed workflow and agent; q5 numeric replaced by an agent-fit item; q2 option c split; hybrid-design item added.

Pass 2 (REVISE): q3 stem hands over the answer; q4/q5 overlap; weak distractors in q5/q6; M14 and M16 shared by different beliefs; q6 wording and a claim contradicting learning record 0002; flat claims in the q3 rationale.
Changed: q5 rebuilt with multi-step requests and a correct open-ended one; q6 reworded to a true-advantage item and the step-limit distractor removed; distinct ids for q5 beliefs; q3 option c and rationale softened.
Not changed: q3's stem still names the three booking steps, since the item applies the idea to a known path; q4 and q5 stay separate (hybrid design vs. choosing an agent request), and no stretch item was added; no lesson exists for O4, so this works as a diagnostic.

Result: ended at the cap with open findings: q3 stem cue, q4/q5 partial overlap, no extra stretch item.
EOF
